findings.text: CPL dropped 42% in 7 days to a 28-day average of $2.61; Google Ads delivering 743 conversions on $1,942 spend — efficiency is confirmed strong.
3-day lead signal is collapsing: Nov 19–21 averaged 29 leads/day vs Nov 16–18 avg of 52 — spend is rising ($148 on Nov 21) but leads dropped to 2 on Nov 21.
GBP call rates flagged low at 6 locations; Canton 0.77% and Fishers 0.69% are the weakest — high impressions (27k–26k) not converting to calls despite active Google Ads.
GBP actions dropped 43.75% week-over-week; Nov 20 shows 309 actions and Nov 21 shows 0 — likely a data connector lag, not a true collapse, but needs confirmation.

suggestions.text: Watch Nov 21 lead crash (2 leads, $148 spend): confirm whether tracking gap or real drop before any budget move.
Fix GBP call-to-action gap at Canton (0.77%) and Fishers (0.69%): audit GBP phone number accuracy and add a call CTA to posts.
Watch GBP actions zero-read on Nov 20–21; confirm connector lag before treating as organic drop.
